description: An example of an auditor's form. The company's own (its ten observations and its scored points) goes in config/qa.local.json, which git ignores, and is named in QA_FORM_FILE.

checks.label: The agent greeted the customer and named the company
The agent understood what the customer called about before answering
The product or service was explained correctly
The price and the delivery terms were stated clearly
An objection or doubt was answered, not brushed aside
The agent stayed polite and did not interrupt
The call ended with a clear next step for the customer
The agent thanked the customer and closed the call properly

scores.label: Clarity and tone of the agent
